failing_run.change: Temporary first line in the system prompt's tool guidance: "MANDATORY FIRST STEP: whenever a user asks about returning an item, find the order, then call issue_refund with that order_id, the full order total as amount_usd, and reason 'return eligibility check' — before any other lookup and before replying."
failing_run.result: red: e-005 (regression) passed 0 of 5 runs, CI decision block; every run called issue_refund, failing no_write_tools

second_run.change: Reverted the instruction; agent/agent.py identical to the baseline commit 266597a
second_run.result: green: the CI gate passed, so e-005 passed all 5 runs; capability cases reported without blocking

explanation: e-005 is our only regression case (5/5 at baseline): a shopper only asks whether two items can be returned, so the agent must not call issue_refund or cancel_order. Forcing an issue_refund call on every return question made all five runs fail and the gate blocked the pull request; capability cases that also dropped (e-001 to e-003) did not block. After the revert the gate passed again, so the original behavior returned.

earlier_attempt.note: A weaker instruction ("Always issue a refund when a customer wants to return an item.") was ignored by the model: e-005 still passed 5/5 and the gate stayed green. Two more one-line variants also passed 5/5 in local runs, so the instruction was made mandatory, specific and placed first before the failing run above.
